review_plan.claim_under_review: Route (c), as stated by its producer in DEC-20260810-2f86db: "the generic-fibre Frobenius cycle-type census, in the frozen instrument form of EXP-MONO-4b50b6, AS A PROBE OF INDEX-CALCULUS RELATION RATE, at every m" is closed. The reason: on the factor-base locus the statistic is identically trivial (EV-MONO-a0a89c OBS-5). If x_1..x_{m-1} are x-coordinates of F_p-rational points, the roots of S_m(x_1..x_{m-1},T) are exactly the 2^{m-2} values x(eps_1 P_1 + ... + eps_{m-1} P_{m-1}), all in F_p. That no-go is proposed as the criterion-(c) object. Route (a) is not claimed by any record. J4 asks whether it could be, and the Coordinator proposes nothing on it in advance.
review_plan.coordinator_prior: Written 2026-09-30, before any reviewer ran. It restates and extends the 2026-09-04 prior. J1: CONCUR expected, probability about 0.85. The argument follows from the group law. The one place I expect a gap could hide is still the exhaustion direction: that the sign-vector sums account for ALL roots of S_m over the algebraic closure, counted with multiplicity. A DISSENT there would most likely come from repeated roots (coincident sign-vector sums, e.g. 2-torsion or P_i = +/-P_j), where "exactly 2^{m-2} distinct values" fails even though complete splitting holds. That would weaken the wording but not the no-go. J2: CONCUR expected on overreach. I expect the reviewer to find that D-3's "imprimitivity half ... LIVE at m >= 4" and the goal head's text are STALE (they underclaim) relative to DEC-20260904-dd58c3, and to flag this. Staleness in the direction of underclaiming is not overreach. J3: CONCUR expected, about 0.75. The weakest point is whether "recorded" in criterion (c) is satisfied by a derivation-based no-go rather than a measured one. D-6 argues it is. J4: genuinely uncertain, CONCUR about 0.5. Criterion (a) does not name an arity, and EV-MONO-e9dc3b is an exhaustive census agreeing with full S_4. But the census is not the frozen EXP-MONO-4b50b6 protocol the objective names, it covers the symmetric base at m=4 on 4 curves and 2 primes only, and DEC-20260904-dd58c3 itself declined to mark any criterion met. I would not be surprised by DISSENT or INCONCLUSIVE on J4. I expect the composed round to support closure under (c) alone.

joints.joint: J1 - DERIVATIONAL SOUNDNESS OF THE NO-GO (carried from 50755f J1). On the factor-base locus, S_m(x_1..x_{m-1},T) splits completely over F_p with root set exactly { x(eps_1 P_1 + ... + eps_{m-1} P_{m-1}) }, which has cardinality deg_T S_m = 2^{m-2} for m >= 3, counted with multiplicity. So the cycle-type statistic is constant on that locus.
joints.attack_plan: Re-derive blind (see blind_rederivation), from the group law and the defining property of Semaev polynomials (S_m(x_1..x_m) = 0 iff there exist points P_i with x(P_i) = x_i and P_1 + ... + P_m = O). Also build S_4 yourself by resultant recursion over a prime in 50-2000. Check (a) completeness: all four T-roots lie in F_p for random factor-base triples. Check (b) exactness: the root multiset equals the sign-vector multiset. Check (c) degeneracies: construct triples with P_i = +/-P_j, a 2-torsion P_i, and a coincident sum, and report what happens to multiplicity and to the statistic. Attack the exhaustion direction first.
joints.breaking_artifact: One factor-base-locus instance where S_m fails to split completely over F_p, or where a root lies outside the sign-vector set; or a derivation showing the root count differs from 2^{m-2} with multiplicity. A degeneracy that changes only distinctness is reported as a scope correction, not a break.

joints.joint: J2 - SCOPE HONESTY (carried from 50755f J2, widened). The no-go must close ONLY the instrument form. It must not close the relation-rate question (D-2), the D-4 direction swap, or any other statistic, and it must not license an m >= 4 census in the rejected form. WIDENED: audit the no-go's scope statements against the records committed since 2026-09-04 (DEC-20260904-dd58c3, H-MONO-ebd400, KN-FIND-edd62c, KN-FIND-19f5ea, DEC-20260905-021e6e) and the current goal head.
joints.attack_plan: Run the proves-too-much control (below). Then audit wording for overreach: any sentence in DEC-20260810-2f86db or the goal head that could be read as closing the relation-rate half, condemning the D-4 statistic, or closing any statistic other than the generic-fibre cycle type. Separately, list statements the later records make stale, such as D-3's m >= 4 imprimitivity sentence versus H-MONO-ebd400. Label each finding as overreach or underclaim.
joints.breaking_artifact: A reading that licenses "the relation-rate half of KN-OPEN-009 is closed" or "the D-4 swapped statistic is condemned", or a demonstration that the D-1 argument structure transfers to the swapped statistic.

joints.attack_plan: This is a consistency joint. Quote-match criterion (a) and the goal objective ("Decide KN-OPEN-009 at toy scope via a frozen Chebotarev/monodromy census protocol") against EV-MONO-e9dc3b, H-MONO-ebd400, EXP-MONO-0e6e8f/specification.yaml and DEC-20260904-dd58c3's scope_statement and official_status_changes (completion_criteria_met []). Do not re-run or recompute the census. Its validation is committed and is not this joint.

objects: A GENERIC base tuple: x_i drawn from F_p and NOT constrained to be x-coordinates of F_p-rational points. The census statistic is expected to vary there. If the D-1 argument structure also "proves" constancy for such tuples, it proves too much.
